jobs.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer (Backend/Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD96547

Senior Principal Software Engineer (Backend/Full Stack)

Location:
Krakow, Poland (Hybrid)

Position Overview

Autodesk is expanding its engineering presence in Krakow and is looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer
(Backend/Full Stack) to help shape the future of our Smart Factory and Facility Operations platforms. While the target solutions are focused on Go (Golang) and React/JavaScript/TypeScript, we are open to candidates with experience in other technology stacks as well.

You will work across teams and disciplines to build our next-generation cloud web application platform – Tandem – that connects data and workflows across Industry 4.0, Industrial IoT (IIoT), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Digital Twin solutions.

This is a high-impact technical leadership (tech lead) role focused on driving platform strategy and architecture (partnering with experienced Autodesk senior architects) and delivering scalable cloud-native services that support mission-critical customer workflows.

This is a unique opportunity to influence technical direction, solve complex software engineering challenges, and mentor engineers while remaining hands-on with design and development.

Join us in building software for people who design and make the world around us. From advanced manufacturing, sustainable buildings and resilient infrastructure to media experiences, Autodesk empowers innovators to solve complex challenges through technology.

Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end delivery of major web application initiatives, from technical strategy and system design through implementation and operational excellence.
Design and build scalable, resilient, and secure cloud-native services that support high-volume production workloads – with a focus on backend services while contributing to frontend development when needed.
Partner with Autodesk Architects and Engineering Leaders to define and drive the technical vision and architecture for critical platform services.
Contribute hands-on to software development across full-stack technologies with a focus on Go/C++ backends and React frontends (flexibly adapting to other technologies where appropriate)
Establish engineering standards, architectural patterns, and best practices that improve platform quality, reliability, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, and Engineering leaders to align technical investments with business objectives.
Guide teams through complex technical challenges, balancing long-term architecture with near-term delivery goals.
Lead design reviews, provide technical mentorship, and elevate engineering excellence across multiple teams.
Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
Champion operational excellence through observability, automation, reliability engineering, and continuous improvement practices.
Participate in Agile planning and execution activities while helping teams continuously improve delivery practices.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
12+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale commercial software systems.
Strong experience designing distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native web applications and APIs
Proven experience leading the architecture and delivery of complex software platform initiatives spanning multiple teams
Deep expertise in software engineering, with strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Go (Golang), C++, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, C#, Python, Java or similar (experience with Go and C++ is particularly valued)
Experience with any modern cloud platform such as AWS (preferred) or Azure.
Strong understanding of data architecture and database technologies.
Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and modern software delivery practices.
Strong understanding of system design, scalability, reliability, security, and performance optimization.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with industrial and manufacturing domains (design, simulation, digital twin, operations), Smart Factory/Industry 4.0 solutions, Industrial IoT (IIoT), facility operations, asset management, AEC etc.
Experience with WebGL, 3D visualization technologies and micro-frontends.
Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and cloud observability practices.
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

About Atos Group

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 56,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion (at the go-forward perimeter), operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is the brand under which Atos SE (Societas Europaea) operates. Atos SE listed on Euronext Paris.

The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.

About Eviden

Eviden is the Atos Group brand for hardware and software products with c. € 1 billion in revenue, operating in 36 countries and comprising four business units advanced computing, cybersecurity products, mission-critical systems and vision AI. As a next-generation technology leader, Eviden offers a unique combination of hardware and software technologies for businesses, public sector and defense organizations and research institutions, helping them to create value out of their data. Bringing together more than 4,500 world-class talents and holding more than 2,100 patents, Eviden provides a strong portfolio of innovative and eco-efficient solutions in AI, computing, security, data and applications.

Application Engineer (Azure DevOps / IIS / .NET)

B2B Contract | 100% Remote - Poland

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Application Engineer to join the OPERA EVO project, supporting a mission-critical platform used by client. The role focuses on application deployments, environment management, CI/CD processes, release activities, and operational support across multiple environments.

Responsibilities

Deploy and maintain application releases across Development, Test, Training, and Production environments
Manage application configuration and environment setup
Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines
Administer and troubleshoot ASP.NET applications hosted on Microsoft IIS
Provide 2nd line application support and incident resolution
Monitor application health, logs, and performance
Support release management, upgrades, and security patching

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field
Minimum 8 years of experience in IT
Minimum 3 years of experience in application administration, deployment management, DevOps, or release management
Experience supporting enterprise-scale or mission-critical applications
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines
Experience with Microsoft IIS and ASP.NET application administration
Knowledge of Git, Active Directory, Group Policies, Service Accounts, and Windows security concepts
English level B2 or higher

Nice to Have

Azure Pipelines
Microsoft SQL Server or other relational databases
Agile software delivery experience
Infrastructure automation knowledge
Experience maintaining complex enterprise application environments

What We Offer

Hybrid work you can truly shape – friendly model designed for real work-life balance (max. 2 office days per month or less, depending on location)
Fair compensation – salary matched to your experience
Feel good at work – passion-sharing meetups, team moments and initiatives
Private medical care
Benefits platform – shopping, cinema and sports discounts
Stay active – Multisport + b-active
Grow your skills – courses and certifications
Level up professionally – conferences and knowledge hubs
Gift packages and recognition programs
Additional days off and experience-based benefits
Charity and eco initiatives

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm or Tallinn – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

You will join one of our product teams and on a daily basis:

Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and other workflows
Initiate, participate in, and communicate technical architecture designs
Attend regular scrum ceremonies as a member of an agile cross-functional team
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Qualifications

What you bring:

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs
Years of experience using relational databases, preferably SQL Server. Additionally, working knowledge of ORMs, preferably Entity Framework
Familiarity with cloud development; experience with Azure is a bonus
Practical knowledge of using messaging platforms in a distributed architecture (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka)
Knowledge and experience on a FinTech and banking industry is a plus
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and sound judgement about reviewing and testing what they produce, is a plus
Fluent English

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Germany.

About The Technologies We Use

Our teams have autonomy when it comes to tech choices. The example below will give you some insights, and we are looking forward to discussing this further with you.

All solutions developed cloud-native targeting Azure - Infrastructure defined using Terraform - Services deployed to Kubernetes clusters by default - A growing microservice ecosystem with event-based integration - Using latest .NET Core - RESTful API design - Single-page frontend apps served by CDN - Frontend tech using TypeScript, often Angular or standard Web Components (Stencil) - Automated tests in each layer.

Additional Information

jobs.description:

to design, develop, and maintain scalable integration solutions using Azure services, including Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and Python-based scripting. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to create efficient, robust, and scalable data pipelines, APIs, and business processes within the Azure cloud ecosystem.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

Data Integration:
Design and implement data pipelines for moving, transforming, and storing data across systems using Azure Data Factory (ADF) or Logic Apps, ensuring seamless integration of data from on-premises, SaaS, and cloud applications
Azure Logic Apps Development:
Design, develop, and maintain Azure Logic Apps to automate business processes and data workflows by integrating various services (APIs, databases, storage)
Azure Functions Development:
Build and deploy Azure Functions for event-driven tasks, real-time data processing, and system integrations with other Azure services (e.g., Cosmos DB, Blob Storage)
Python Coding & Automation:
Develop Python scripts to automate processes, handle data transformation, and support custom business logic, with reusable modules interacting with Azure services and APIs
Collaboration & Documentation:
Collaborate with DevOps, data engineers, and other teams for smooth deployment and operation of solutions. Create documentation, including technical specifications and architectural diagrams, for the developed solutions

Requirements:

You are an experienced Azure developer with a passion for designing scalable solutions. You can manage multiple tasks independently while excelling in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

Qualifications:

Proficiency in developing Azure Logic Apps and Azure Functions
Experience with Python scripting for automation and data processing
Experience in SQL
Understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party API integration
Experience with data integration tools like Azure Data Factory (ADF) or Synapse Pipelines
Proven experience in data integration projects within the Azure cloud ecosystem

  Meriting Skills:

Experience with serverless architectures and event-driven systems
Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD pipelines for Azure resource deployment
Familiarity with version control (Git) and project management tools (Jira, Azure DevOps)

Personal Attributes:

Excellent communication skills, enabling effective collaboration with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong problem-solving ability, with a focus on delivering solutions that meet business and technical requirements
A proactive team player who enjoys working with colleagues across different disciplines

Benefits

jobs.title: Regional Integration Specialist hos Toyota Northern Europe
jobs.description:
Vill du ta ägarskap för en kritisk integrationsplattform och vara med och forma hur ett globalt bolag bygger sin digitala ryggrad? Trivs du i gränslandet mellan teknik och affär och vill ha en roll där du faktiskt får mandat, påverkan och internationell räckvidd?

Då kan detta vara nästa steg för dig.

OM ROLLEN

Som Regional Integration Specialist hos Toyota Northern Europe får du en central roll i organisationens pågående digitaliseringsresa, där integrationslagret är avgörande för att koppla samman affärssystem, dataflöden och processer på ett skalbart, säkert och långsiktigt hållbart sätt. Du tar ett tydligt ägarskap för Toyotas Workato‑plattform i regionen och ansvarar för den arkitekturella riktningen, kvaliteten i integrationerna samt att arbetssätt, dokumentation och struktur håller en hög och enhetlig nivå.

I rollen ansvarar du för styrning och vidareutveckling av integrationsplattformen, inklusive struktur, säkerhet och gemensamma standarder för hur integrationer byggs, testas och dokumenteras. Du säkerställer att lösningarna följer Toyotas riktlinjer och bidrar till att sätta ramverk och best practices för regionen.

Du arbetar hands‑on med teknisk leverans och arkitektur, där du designar och driver integrationer mot centrala affärssystem, fungerar som teknisk kvalitetssäkrare och hanterar mer komplexa integrationsutmaningar. En viktig del av uppdraget är även arbete med API‑design, felhantering samt övervakning och uppföljning för att säkerställa stabil och tillförlitlig drift.

Samarbete är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du fungerar som teknisk rådgivare till verksamhet och projekt, samverkar med IT‑kollegor i Norden och Baltikum samt har löpande dialog med externa leverantörer och Workato‑support. Parallellt arbetar du långsiktigt med förvaltning och kontinuerlig förbättring, där du utvecklar integrationslandskapet, stöttar interna resurser och bidrar till roadmap och budget för integrationsområdet.

DIN PROFIL

Du är en erfaren integrationsutvecklare som trivs med ansvar och helhetsperspektiv. Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och bekväm med att arbeta självständigt, samtidigt som du har lätt för att samarbeta och skapa förtroende hos olika stakeholders. Du har en naturlig förmåga att skapa ordning och tydlighet i komplexa miljöer och kommunicerar tekniska lösningar på ett pedagogiskt sätt.

Krav

Minst 3 års erfarenhet av integrationsarbete, gärna i enterprise‑miljö
Praktisk erfarenhet av Workato eller annan iPaaS‑plattform (t.ex. MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Logic Apps)
Goda kunskaper i REST API, JSON, XML och autentiseringslösningar
Erfarenhet av integrationer mot affärssystem som Salesforce, Snowflake, Microsoft 365 eller liknande
Förmåga att kommunicera tekniska lösningar till icke‑tekniska stakeholders
Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande

Workato‑certifiering (Automation Pro I/II eller liknande)
Erfarenhet från bilindustrin, retail‑nätverk eller multinationell organisation
Kännedom om Toyota Production System (TPS) eller liknande förbättringsmetodik
Erfarenhet av agilt arbetssätt och tvärfunktionella team

OM TOYOTA

Toyota är ett globalt varumärke med starkt fokus på kvalitet, hållbarhet och långsiktig utveckling. Hos Toyota möter du en stark och värderingsstyrd företagskultur, grundad i The Toyota Way – en levande kultur som genomsyrar vardagen och sättet att arbeta tillsammans.

KONTAKT OCH ANSÖKAN

I denna rekrytering samarbetar Toyota Northern Europe med Wise IT. Vill du veta mer, kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Sandra Åhs på sandra.ahs@wise.se.

Vi kan tyvärr inte ta emot ansökningar via mail då vi värnar om din personliga integritet. Du kan läsa mer om hur vi behandlar personuppgifter enligt GDPR i Wise Group-koncernens policy för behandling av personuppgifter.

Vi arbetar med ett löpande urval så tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

About The Role

At Databricks, we are looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Nordics Hunter team. You will be the technical lead for our most strategic new engagements in the region, with the mission to establish Databricks as the main data & AI platform on Greenfield accounts. You aren't just a technical resource; you are a strategic advisor who raises the bar for how our customers build and reason through data solutions.

You will thrive in rapid growth environments and high-paced customer engagements, creating structure in ambiguous situations and driving commitment from senior stakeholders even when priorities shift. Whether you come from a pre-sales background or have deep technical expertise in complex systems, your ability to manage high-level stakeholders and deliver measurable business outcomes is what will make you successful.

The Impact You Will Have

Technical Strategy & Leadership: Lead the technical strategy for Greenfield accounts within the Nordics - assessing a customer’s architecture and provide strategic guidance and deep technical expertise addressing problems that span multiple systems, teams, and stakeholders, from data & AI practitioners, business domains and all the way up to C-level.
Executive Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to VP+ and BU-level leaders, driving alignment during high-tension negotiations and ensuring long-term technical commitment.
Raise the Bar: Abstract learnings from your builds into reusable patterns and guidance for the wider Databricks community, anticipating objections before they surface.
Drive Adoption: Move beyond "proof of concept" to deliver outcomes the business can measure, using adoption signals to ensure sustained customer impact.
Mentorship: Coach junior and professional SAs on technical discovery and complex use-case prioritization, helping the team maintain high standards at sustained velocity.

What We Look For

Note - you do not need to fulfil every single requirement to be a strong candidate. If you are excited about this role and have related experience, we encourage you to apply.*
8+ years of experience in technical and client-facing roles.
Deep expertise across the data landscape—including Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, and GenAI—with a strong "AI-Builder" mindset.
Proven ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across competing constraints and evolving goals.
Recognized as an experienced architect who can confidently lead technical discussions and solve high-complexity, multi-account architectural challenges.
Ability to execute through ambiguity: A track record of identifying emerging risks early and mobilizing others to act, even when full information is not available.
Pre-sales experience is a plus, but we value deep technical expertise and stakeholder management skills above all as key must-haves.
Language & Location: Must be based in Sweden or Denmark with excellent communication skills suited for top-tier customer interactions.

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. solutions, ensuring they are scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned with wider business objectives.

.

Mentor and coach developers and other technical team members, helping to raise engineering capability.

We're looking for a strong .NET/Azure technical architect

Extensive commercial experience with C#, .NET Framework and modern .NET
.
Strong practical experience designing and developing solutions on Microsoft Azure
.
Strong understanding of Azure PaaS
services and cloud development patterns.
Proven experience designing complex, scalable and maintainable software systems.
Strong knowledge of software architecture patterns, development principles and engineering best practices.
Experience with SQL Server and Entity Framework
.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and API-led integration
.
Experience with Azure DevOps

Awareness of accessibility standards
and their application within software solutions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and influence stakeholders at different levels.

We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.

We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.

Job Description

Senior Integration Engineer

We are seeking an experienced API Engineer to design, build, secure, and operate enterprise-grade APIs that integrate cloud platforms with on‑premise banking application suites. The role focuses on developing reliable and scalable integration services, enabling secure data exchange across channels and systems (core banking, payments, fraud, risk, CRM, digital platforms), while meeting stringent regulatory, availability, and security requirements.

You will work closely with solution architects, platform engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders to deliver API products aligned to bank integration patterns, including synchronous REST services and event-driven integrations.

Direct line reporting:

Head of Architecture and Core Banking – Europe.
Accountabilities And Responsibilities

API Design & Delivery

Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration services connecting cloud services to on‑prem banking systems.
Create reusable API patterns for common banking capabilities (customer, accounts, payments, transactions, entitlements).
Define and maintain API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), versioning strategies, and backward compatibility.
Deliver APIs that meet performance, latency, availability, and resiliency expectations (e.g., timeouts, retries, circuit breakers).

Security, Compliance & Controls

Implement strong API security controls: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, JWT validation, request signing, API gateway policies, and rate limiting.
Apply secure coding practices and align solutions with bank security standards, audit requirements, and regulatory expectations (e.g., least privilege, encryption in transit/at rest).
Collaborate with security to support threat modeling, pen test remediation, and secure configuration management.

Cloud–On‑Prem Connectivity & Integration

Build and operate integration flows using enterprise tooling (examples: API gateway, service mesh, ESB/iPaaS, message brokers).
Implement hybrid connectivity patterns such as VPN/ExpressRoute/Direct Connect equivalents, private endpoints, network segmentation, and secure routing.
Integrate with on‑prem technologies (e.g., MQ, legacy services, SOAP where required, databases, batch systems) and modern cloud services.

Observability & Operations

Implement observability: structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
Support production deployments and incident triage; conduct root cause analysis and introduce reliability improvements.
Automate CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure/Configuration as Code where applicable.

Engineering Excellence

Write clean, testable code (unit/integration/contract tests).
Participate in code reviews, technical design reviews, and architecture governance.
Document API products and integration runbooks for support and operational readiness.
Experience and Key Competencies:

Knowledge & Experience:

5+ years (adjust as needed) developing APIs/integration services in regulated enterprise environments; banking or financial services experience strongly preferred.
BA/MBA in IT or relevant experience
Proven experience building hybrid integrations: cloud to on‑prem application connectivity and secure data exchange.
Strong hands-on experience with API design, implementation, and lifecycle management.

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in one or more of: Java (Spring Boot), .NET, Node.js, or Python for API development.
Strong experience with API gateways (e.g., Apigee, Kong, Azure API Management, AWS API Gateway, Mulesoft, etc.).
Experience with messaging/eventing platforms: Kafka, MQ, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, etc.
Experience with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift.
Strong understanding of integration patterns: sync/async, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, backpressure, saga/compensation, and data consistency.
Strong understanding of data formats (JSON, XML, Avro) and schema evolution.

Security & Quality

Practical experience implementing OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, certificate management, secrets management (e.g., Vault, Key Vault, Secrets Manager).
Experience with SDLC controls: SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, secure CI pipelines.
Test automation: unit tests, integration tests, consumer-driven contract testing (e.g., Pact).

Personal Attributes

Highly organised, proactive, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to operate at pace.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
Resilient, calm under pressure, and confident acting as an extension of the CIO.
Trusted partner with a collaborative, inclusive leadership style.
Banking domain knowledge: payments (SEPA/SWIFT), card processing, transaction monitoring, AML/KYC, customer onboarding.
Exposure to 4th generation banking platforms such as (Thought Machine or 10X)
Experience with service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and zero trust patterns.
Familiarity with TOGAF, enterprise integration architecture, or API product management.
Experience with data privacy and retention requirements (GDPR), and operational controls.

Key Competencies:

Communications & Relationships:

Excellent communication skills required to manage third party relationships. Ability to use insights and relationships to influence and deliver. The ability to build connections and partnerships within own business area and beyond, through formal and informal channels, utilising considerable tact, diplomacy and people skills.

Agility and innovation:

Adapt quickly to changing priorities; create new and better ways for the organization to be successful.

Collaboration:

Build partnerships and promote a culture of teamwork to drive on U.S. Bank.

Drive for results:

Hold self and others accountable to consistently achieve meaningful results.

Ethics and trust:

Maintain high ethical standards; gain the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity and authenticity.

Inclusion:

Build a culture of equity and inclusion in which diverse ideas, talent and perspectives are welcomed and encouraged.

Customer centricity:

Build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions.

Commercial Judgement:

Strong knowledge of business unit with the ability to understand USBE’s business and deliver the business performance needed to achieve USBE’s purpose and goals.

Managing Programs:

Proven analytical, decision-making and problem-solving skills, with the ability to plan and implement appropriate measures to mitigate the impact of an event affecting USBE’s ability to achieve its objectives. To complete day-to-day activities in a manner which is consistent with legal, regulatory and stakeholder expectations.

3 Conduct Standards & Rules

You must act with due skill and diligence
You must be open and cooperative with the Central Bank of Ireland and other regulators
You must disclose appropriately any information of which the Central Bank of Ireland would reasonably expect notice

Location expectations

U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value.

We're on a mission to help design better cities. With 90% of future population growth expected in cities and construction responsible for 40% of global CO₂ emissions, the AEC industry must evolve. We're a fundamentally agile organization, built on empowered teams that have the freedom to innovate at speed while staying aligned. We believe in servant leadership and team accountability, so teams are trusted to find the best way to develop their solutions, with a bottom-up approach to decision-making. jobs.title: DevOps Architect
jobs.description:
Er du klar for å bygge Azure -plattformer som faktisk havner i produksjon, ikke bare i PowerPoint?  
Vil du bli del av et fagmiljø som deler kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess – og som liker folk som både kan kode, forklare og utfordre?  
Vil du jobbe i Oslo hos en global Microsoft-partner, med lokale kollegaer, store kunder og prosjekter som sjelden er små?  

Vi har skrevet stillingen som kode. Nå mangler vi bare deg som kjører apply .

resource " devops_arkitekt " "softwareone" {  
  location = "Oslo" # men magien skjer hos kunden  
  language = [  
    " norsk ", # ( flytende )  
    " engelsk "  
  ]  
  security_clearance = " må-kunne-oppnås "  
  stack              = [  
    "Azure",  
    "Terraform",  
    "Bicep",  
    "Kubernetes/ containere "  
  ]  
  cost_conscious      = true  
}  

Terraform vil utføre følgende handlinger:  

# devops_arkitekt.softwareone vil bli opprettet  
+ ansettelse  

Plan: 1 å legge til, 0 å endre, 0 å ødelegge.  

Vil du utføre disse handlingene?  
Skriv 'ja' for å bekrefte. ▊  
Hvorfor akkurat denne rollen ?

De fleste arkitektroller ender opp i PowerPoint. Denne ender i produksjon.  
Som DevOps Arkitekt hos oss sitter du ikke og tegner mållandskap for et selskap du aldri møter. Du sitter hos kunden, der kompleksiteten faktisk bor, der legacy -systemet ingen tør å røre står ved siden av landingssonen dere skal bygge. Du får eierskapet fra første workshop til siste pipeline-kjøring.  
Og du gjør det uten å brenne kundens budsjett. Vi mener at god arkitektur er billigere enn dårlig arkitektur, og vi ser etter deg som klarer å forsvare en teknisk beslutning både overfor en utvikler og en økonomidirektør, i samme møte.  
L urer du på hvorfor selskaps navnet ikke klinger helt: mye av miljøet du kommer inn i, er det du kjenner som Crayon. Vi er nå SoftwareOne – samme fagfolk, samme kunder, større ryggdekning.  
Og internt er det høyt under taket. Stor tillit, kort vei til beslutninger, og et team som deler kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess. Du får rom til å utvikle deg i den retningen du selv vil.  
Dette blir hverdagen din

Designe og bygge infrastruktur i Azure ,  landingssoner, nettverk, sikkerhet og styring – etter beste praksis, ikke etter vane  

Skrive infrastruktur som kode i Terraform og/eller Bicep , slik at det som funker i dag også funker om to år og tre konsulenter  

Kjøre containerbaserte plattformer på Kubernetes , eller ta steget dit sammen med kunden  

Være kundens tekniske og strategiske motpart – den som sier «det der bør vi ikke gjøre», og som blir hørt  

Holde workshops og dele kunnskap med både teknikere og folk som ikke vet hva en YAML-fil er, og ikke burde måtte vite det  

Bruke KI aktivt i eget arbeid, og være nysgjerrig på hvordan det endrer måten vi leverer på

Vi tror du kjenner deg igjen i minst tre av disse

Du har konsulent- og prosjekterfaring, og trives best når du er ute hos kunden.  

Du kan Azure godt, og har erfaring med IaC – Terraform, Bicep eller begge.  

Du har jobbet med Kubernetes , eller i det minste containere, og vet hvorfor det ikke alltid er svaret.  

Du tenker kostnad og verdi før du tenker teknologi.  

Du har en gang skrevet « temporary fix » i en kommentar som fortsatt står i produksjon. Vi dømmer ikke. Vi har alle vært der.  

Erfaring fra AWS, GCP eller OVH Cloud er en fin bonus, vi jobber teknologiuavhengig.  

Job Requirements
H va du får igje n?

Et fagmiljø som faktisk deler – kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess. Sertifiseringer og kurs. Tett oppfølging fra din leder, med retning i egen utvikling.  
Naprapat på huset, og forsikrings- og pensjonsordning  

Rabatter på blant annet SATS, Ruter og Visma-biblioteket  

Dekket mobil og internett  

Rekrutteringsbonus når du henter inn en god kollega  

Nye lokaler med kantine, innendørs sykkelparkering og verksted, garderober, shuffleboard og eget hvilerom  

Hovedsponsor for Vålerenga Ishockey: trening på Jordal Amfi og tilgang til VIP-losje på Jordal  

Stay Social , Stay Professional og Stay Active – tre interne grupper som sørger for at året består av mer enn sprinter  

Om SoftwareOne

Vi er verdens største Microsoft-partner. Det betyr ikke så mye i seg selv, men det betyr at når du sitter hos en kunde og trenger å vite hvor Microsoft faktisk er på vei, så finnes svaret et sted i huset. Og at prosjektene som kommer inn døra sjelden er de små.  
Det betyr også bredde. Vi jobber på tvers av lisens, sky, sikkerhet og applikasjoner, så teknologivalgene du anbefaler kan følges hele veien, ikke bare til neste fakturagrense. Du får jobbe med kunder i mange bransjer, fra virksomheter som tar sine første steg i Azure til de som har levd der lenge nok til å ha samlet på teknisk gjeld.  
Klar for å kjøre apply ?

Send søknad. Vi lover å svare fortere enn en cold start på en Kubernetes -node en mandag morgen.  
Ingen ressurser vil bli ødelagt i prosessen.

Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Forward Deployed Engineers are the engineering core of Avanade Next. They sit inside the client from week one and turn business ambition into production reality — proving the direction in Consulting with a working prototype, leading the build in Studios, and configuring products for client environments. They work alongside business stakeholders, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand what matters commercially, then build the system that delivers it.

This is not a order-taking role. Forward Deployed Engineers help clients decide what should be built, challenge assumptions where the value is not there, and lead the work through to live deployment. They work in small expert teams directing agent networks rather than large delivery pyramids, and they carry accountability from the first brief through to production — which is unusual, and is the point.

Key Responsibilities

Work with clients, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand business priorities and translate them into practical AI-enabled solutions.
Build and deploy agentic AI systems end-to-end, embedded with the client and shipping from the first weeks of an engagement.
Help clients identify where AI can create meaningful value, challenge assumptions where necessary, and shape solutions that are commercially viable and technically feasible at enterprise scale.
In Consulting: build the working prototype that proves the strategy is real rather than theoretical.

Client outcomes achieved through production deployments, evidenced by business value realised and client referenceability
Production-grade delivery on every engagement; no prototype handed over without a production path.
Demonstrable productivity through AI-native engineering practices and agent utilisation.
Reusable assets contributed to the library from every engagement.

Experience building and evaluating agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, and failure handling.
Comfortable being deployed into a client environment with high autonomy and direct exposure to stakeholders.

jobs.title: Μηχανικοί λογισμικού (Backend/Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Περιγραφή Η CITE ζητά να επεκτείνει τις ομάδες ανάπτυξης λογισμικού της με μηχανικούς λογισμικού /προγραμματιστές (full-stack, backend) με πολύ καλή γνώση C# και του οικοσυστήματος DotnetCore. Εμπειρία σε Java και του οικοσυστήματος Spring/Spring Boot εκτιμάται επίσης.
Για υποψήφιους full-stack development πρωτευόντως εκτιμάται η γνώση / εμπειρία Angular και Typescript και δευτερευόντως εμπειρία σε React και άλλα μοντέρνα ανοιχτά front-end frameworks.
Τα επιλεγμένα στελέχη ενταχθούν σε ένα περιβάλλον το οποίο διέπεται από συμμετοχικότητα και καινοτομία, εξελίσσεται ταχύτατα, προωθεί τη μονάδα ώστε να εξελίσσεται μέσα από την υποστήριξη της ομάδας και χαρακτηρίζεται από την σχεδόν παντελή απουσία γερασμένων συστημάτων, τα οποία κατά κανόνα περιορίζουν την εξέλιξη ενός στελέχους στο πεδίο.
Επιλεγμένοι υποψήφιοι θα έχουν την ευκαιρία να εργαστούν σε πολυ-συμμετοχικά μεγάλα έργα ή έργα μεγάλων πελατών με σύγχρονα τεχνολογικά πλαίσια σε ανταγωνιστικούς τομείς της αγοράς (Τραπεζικός Τομέας, Ασφάλεια, Ανάλυση Δεδομένων κοκ) και να βάλουν τα θεμέλια για ισχυρή καριέρα Μηχανικού Λογισμικού.
Για να έρθετε μαζί μας θα χρειαστείτε επαρκή εμπειρία στις ζητούμενες τεχνολογίες καθώς και τίτλο σπουδών ανώτατης εκπαίδευσης, ο οποίος είναι προαπαιτούμενος για κάθε θέση εργασίας μηχανικού λογισμικού στη CITE.
Από εμάς θα πάρετε αμοιβή η οποία θα εξελίσσεται με την πορεία σας, ένα ισχυρό μέλλον ως Software Engineer, όπως επαληθεύεται από νυν και πρώην στελέχη μας!
Τα παρακάτω επίπεδα θέσεων είναι διαθέσιμα:
Entry Developers.
Junior Developers.
Mid-level Developers.
Experienced Developers - Team Leaders.
Senior Developers - Team Leaders.

Οι θέσεις εργασίες αφορούν την Αθήνα ή τη Σπάρτη, κατ' επιλογή του Υποψηφίου, ενώ εξετάζονται δυνατότητες μερικής ή πλήρους τηλε-εργασίας, αναλόγως περίπτωσης.
Σχετικές Τεχνολογίες Για Full-Stack Developers :
Πρωτεύουσα προτίμηση η εξοικείωση ή εμπειρία με το οικοσύστημα Angular και Typescript.
Εναλλακτικά αλλά εκτιμάται εμπειρία σε κυρίως σε React και εν συνεχεία σε άλλα μοντέρνα ανοιχτά πλαίσια.

Για Back-end και Full-Stack Developers :
Απαραίτητη η εξοικείωση ή εμπειρία C# και Dotnetcore. Εμπειρία σε Java/Spring/SpringBoot επίσης εκτιμάται δευτερευόντως.
RESTfull web services.
Εξοικείωση με NoSQL και SQL Databases.
Εξοικείωση με CI/CD pipelines.
Εξοικείωση με τεχνολογίες containerization.

Απαιτήσεις/Εκτιμώμενα Προσόντα ανά Επίπεδο Για Entry level :
Απαιτείται η ύπαρξη εργασιών και πτυχιακής ή διπλωματικής εργασίας στο πεδίο της επιστήμης των υπολογιστών.
Απαιτείται βασικός τίτλος πανεπιστημιακών σπουδών σε Πληροφορική / Τηλεπικοινωνίες (βασικό πτυχίο ή μεταπτυχιακός τίτλος). Τίτλοι σπουδών Φυσικής, Μαθηματικών, Ηλεκτρολόγων Μηχανικών κοκ εκτιμώνται επίσης εφόσον συνοδεύονται από φοίτηση ή τίτλο σε ένα από τα πεδία της επιστήμης των υπολογιστών.

Για Junior Developers :
Απαιτείται συναφής εργασιακή εμπειρία
τουλάχιστον ενός (1) έτους.
Απαιτείται η εμπειρία ή τεκμηριωμένη εξοικείωση σε C# / DotnetCore
Απαιτούνται τίτλοι σπουδών όπως και στις προηγούμενες βαθμίδες.

Για Mid-Level Developers :
Απαιτείται συναφής εργασιακή εμπειρία τουλάχιστον τριών (3) ετών.
Απαιτείται εργασιακή εμπειρία τουλάχιστον δύο (2) ετών στο οικοσύστημα C# / Dotnetcore. 
Εκτιμάται ικανότητα καθοδήγησης ομάδας ανάπτυξης.
Απαιτούνται τίτλοι σπουδών όπως και στις προηγούμενες βαθμίδες.

Για Experienced Developers :
Απαιτείται συναφής εργασιακή εμπειρία τουλάχιστον πέντε (5) ετών.
Απαιτείται εργασιακή εμπειρία τουλάχιστον τριών (3) ετών στο οικοσύστημα C#/Dotnetcore. 
Εκτιμάται ικανότητα καθοδήγησης ομάδας ανάπτυξης.
Απαιτούνται τίτλοι σπουδών όπως και στις προηγούμενες βαθμίδες.

Για Senior Developers :
Απαιτείται συναφής εργασιακή εμπειρία τουλάχιστον επτά (7) ετών.
Απαιτείται εργασιακή εμπειρία τουλάχιστον τριών (3) ετών στο οικοσύστημα C#/Dotnetcore.
Απαιτείται εμπειρία σε σχεδίαση και διαχείριση δοκιμών (καταπόνησης, απόδοσης, ασφαλείας, επαλήθευσης κοκ).
Απαιτείται εμπειρία σε διαδικασίες και πλαίσια διασφάλισης ποιότητας λογισμικού.
Απαιτείται ικανότητα καθοδήγησης ομάδας ανάπτυξης.

Για την εξέταση μίας υποψηφιότητας απαιτούνται κατ’ ελάχιστον να διαθέτουν:
Εκπληρωμένες στρατιωτικές υποχρεώσεις ( Όπου αφορούν, εκτός Entry-level με προοπτική μεταπτυχιακών σπουδών )
Άριστη γνώση Ελληνικής Γλώσσας (γραπτής και ομιλουμένης).
Πολύ καλή γνώση Αγγλικής Γλώσσας (γραπτής και ομιλουμένης).

Επιλεγμένοι υποψήφιοι θα υποβληθούν σε άσκηση ελέγχου επάρκειας γνώσεων σε συγκεκριμένες τεχνολογίες στις οποίες δηλώνουν ευχέρεια.
Διαδικασία και Όροι Εκδήλωσης Ενδιαφέροντος Οι αιτήσεις αποστέλλονται στην ηλεκτρονική διεύθυνση 202609DEV@cite-sa.gr
. Οι αιτούντες είναι επιθυμητό να εξειδικεύουν την αίτησή τους, ως προς τις κατηγορίες θέσεων που τους αφορούν, εφόσον αυτές αναφέρονται στην παρούσα.
Για λεπτομέρειες σχετικά με τη διαδικασία και τους όρους εκδήλωσης ενδιαφέροντος, παρακαλούμε όπως απευθυνθείτε στο σχετικό κείμενο της CITE, το οποίο θα βρείτε στον ιστότοπο (https://www.cite.gr/).
ΠΡΟΣΟΧΗ
: Η υποβολή εκδήλωσης ενδιαφέροντος αποτελεί αποδοχή των όρων που συνοδεύουν την παρούσα ανακοίνωση.
Λίγα λόγια για εμάς Η Communication & Information Technologies Experts SA (CITE) είναι μια Εταιρεία Εμπειρογνωμόνων Λογισμικού που δραστηριοποιείται στον τομέα της υλοποίησης πληροφοριακών συστημάτων , σε ένα ευρύ φάσμα επιχειρηματικών τομέων, συμπεριλαμβανομένων του: τραπεζικού, χρηματοοικονομικού, λογιστικού, ασφάλειας πληροφοριών, έξυπνης γεωργίας, πολιτισμού, εκπαίδευσης, σοβαρών παιγνίων, ηλεκτρονικής διακυβέρνησης, ανοικτής επιστήμης, υποδομών & διαχείρισης περιουσιακών στοιχείων, τεχνοοικονομικών κ.λπ.
Με γραφεία στην Αθήνα και τη Σπάρτη και μια ομάδα 40+ εξειδικευμένων μηχανικών λογισμικού, η εταιρεία σχεδιάζει, αναπτύσσει και υποστηρίζει πληροφοριακά συστήματα μεγάλης κλίμακας χρησιμοποιώντας τεχνολογίες αιχμής. Οι υπηρεσίες της CITE απευθύνονται κατά κανόνα σε μεγάλους οργανισμούς, κυβερνητικούς φορείς, πολυεθνικές εταιρείες και κοινοπραξίες.
Η CITE δραστηριοποιείται και στη βιομηχανική έρευνα και καινοτομία, σχεδιάζοντας και εφαρμόζοντας λύσεις αιχμής για κατανεμημένες υποδομές και υποδομές υπολογιστικού νέφους, οι οποίες καλύπτουν πεδία όπως ανάκτηση πληροφορίας (μεγάλης / κειμενικής), διαχείριση δεδομένων, εξειδικευμένη προσομοίωση και μοντελοποίηση φαινομένων, (κατανεμημένη) ανάλυση δεδομένων, επεξεργασία και οπτικοποίηση κ.λπ.
Οι τεχνολογίες, που αναπτύσσει ή χρησιμοποιεί κατά κύριο λόγο, είναι οι εξής:
Backend services: .NetCore (C#) / Java (Spring Framework) / [PHP]
Mobile application development: Java / Objective C / Swift & cross platform (Xamarin / React Native)
Web UI: Angular - TypeScript / React / HTML5 (+JS & CSS3 ) κα.
SQL & NoSQL data stores: Microsoft SQL Server/ PostGreSQL / MySQL / Elastic Search/ MongoDB κλπ.
Distributed platforms / analytics: Hadoop / Spark.
Security: SSO protocols, AAI.
Virtualisation / Containerisation: Docker/Kubernetes κλπ.
Geospatial data management and visualization: OpenLayers / OpenGIS / GeoServer / Mapserver / WMS-WCS-WCPS-WPS-CSW κλπ.

Σχέση Εργασίας Αορίστου χρόνου, πλήρους απασχόλησης σχέση εργασίας.

Αμοιβές Ανταγωνιστικός μισθός αναλόγως προσόντων.
Πρόσθετες ανταμοιβές απόδοσης και συνέπειας.

Τοποθεσία Εργασίας Οι προσληφθέντες θα εργαστούν σε υποκατάστημα της εταιρείας σε μία από τις παρακάτω τοποθεσίες, σύμφωνα με τη δική τους επιλογή:
Καισαριανή (Αθήνα), Αττική, Ελλάς (εξ' ορισμού).
Σπάρτη, Λακωνία, Ελλάς (κατόπιν αιτήματος του υποψηφίου).
Μερικά/Ολικά απομακρυσμένη εργασία εξετάζεται σε κατά περίπτωση.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Our corporate activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a Senior Fullstack .NET Developer
to join our Information Technology team. The Senior Fullstack .NET Developer position will work on a team focused on our core clinical systems as well as internal applications. Strong attention to detail, innovation, and implementation of new technologies are highly valued.

To meet our global and innovation demands, Medpace is rapidly growing our software development footprint beyond the US. to support our growth, we are expanding our existing office in Leuven to build our first non-US development center. This is an incredible opportunity to join, contribute, and shape a new team, while also being a part of a large, fast-growing organization. Our custom software is a key component to our success. You will be joining an organization where your contribution makes a significant impact in positively impacting people's lives, as new treatments and therapeutics are developed.

Responsibilities

Collect, analyze and document user requirements;
Design, modify, develop and support software applications;
Participate in software validation process through development, review, and/or execution of test plan/cases/scripts;
Create software applications by following software development life-cycle, which includes requirements gathering, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance;
Communicate with team members regarding projects, development, tools, and procedures;
Utilize skills in development areas including object oriented programming (C#), databases (SQL) web applications (ASP.NET);
Potential opportunities to lead software development projects.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science;
At least 5 years of software development experience using technologies such as C#, Angular, Webservices, GraphQL, Git, relational databases;
Experience in Entity Framework, Azure DevOps is advantageous;
Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and software release management;
Prior experience modernizing systems to a cloud-based platform (Azure) is a plus;
Excellent analytical, written and oral communication skills in English.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

Office based environment with on-site mentors
Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
Company-sponsored social events

Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

jobs.title: Senior Agentic AI Software Engineer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Beschrijving

Voor onze partner in regio Mechelen zijn we op zoek naar een Senior Agentic Software Engineer die een verschil wil maken. Je komt terecht in een innovatieve R&D-omgeving waar softwareontwikkeling en artificiële intelligentie steeds meer hand in hand gaan.

Samen met een multidisciplinair Scrum-team ontwikkel je moderne cloud-native applicaties op het Microsoft-platform. Je bouwt niet alleen kwalitatieve software, maar speelt ook een actieve rol in de transformatie naar AI-assisted en agentic softwareontwikkeling.

Waar softwareontwikkeling vroeger voornamelijk draaide om het handmatig schrijven van code, werk je vandaag steeds vaker samen met AI-systemen. Je gebruikt AI-tools en software agents om analyses uit te voeren, code te genereren, testen op te zetten, documentatie te creëren en repetitieve engineeringtaken te automatiseren.

Als Senior Agentic Software Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor zowel het ontwikkelen van schaalbare softwareoplossingen als het optimaal inzetten van AI binnen het ontwikkelproces. Je helpt mee de software development lifecycle van morgen vorm te geven en draagt actief bij aan de verdere uitbouw van engineering standaarden, best practices en AI-governance binnen het team.

Greep Uit Jouw Verantwoordelijkheden

Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van schaalbare softwareoplossingen op basis van .NET en Azure.
Actief inzetten van AI-tools zoals GitHub Copilot, Claude Code en vergelijkbare oplossingen als onderdeel van je dagelijkse workflow.
Complexe businessvraagstukken vertalen naar opdrachten die efficiënt door AI-systemen kunnen worden uitgevoerd.
Reviewen, valideren en verbeteren van AI-gegenereerde code, documentatie en analyses.
Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van AI-assisted engineering workflows.
Samenwerken met architecten, product owners en business analisten om kwalitatieve softwareoplossingen te realiseren.
Bijdragen aan technische standaarden, softwarekwaliteit en de verdere professionalisering van AI-gedreven development.
Ondersteunen van collega's bij het adopteren van AI-tools en nieuwe manieren van softwareontwikkeling.

Profiel

Je behaalde een bachelor- of masterdiploma in een relevante richting (Toegepaste Informatica, Software Engineering, Computer Science...).
Je beschikt over minimaal 6 jaar ervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling met .NET-technologieën.
Je hebt ervaring met meerdere van onderstaande technologieën:
C#
.NET 10 (of eerdere moderne .NET-versies)
ASP.NET Core
RESTful API's
CQRS
Domain Driven Design (DDD)
React
Azure Cloud
GitHub Enterprise
GitHub Copilot
Bicep
Je denkt in architectuur, schaalbaarheid en lange termijn onderhoudbaarheid.
Je bent in staat AI-output kritisch te beoordelen en waar nodig te verbeteren.
Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, veiligheid en betrouwbaarheid belangrijker zijn dan louter snelheid.
Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologieën en experimenteert graag met AI-tools.
Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels.

Nice-to-haves

Ervaring met AI-assisted software development.
Kennis van Large Language Models (LLM's).
Ervaring met prompt engineering of context engineering.
Kennis van AI agents en agentic workflows.
Ervaring met Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Azure AI Services.
Observability & monitoring.
DevOps en platform engineering.

Aanbod

Onze partner biedt een loonpakket aan dat aangevuld wordt met o.a.

Maaltijd- en ecocheques
Groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering
Bedrijfsrestaurant met zeer gunstige prijzen
Bedrijfswagen (full electric) met laadkaart
20 + 9 verlofdagen (39,5 urenweek)
1 à 2 thuiswerkdagen per week
Glijtijd: kerntijd is tussen 10.00 -15.00u
Sportiever naar kantoor? Als je +50% met de fiets komt, voorziet onze partner een (elektrische) fiets die door hen wordt onderhouden
Jaarlijks 1 dag vrijwilligerswerk tijdens de werkuren

jobs.title: Full Stack .NET Developer (Innovation Lab)
jobs.description:
Protime
is een succesvolle internationale aanbieder van Workforce Management
oplossingen. Met onze software en expertise helpen wij bedrijven om efficiënter om te gaan met de tijd van hun werknemers: hun Human Capital, dus. Bij Protime krijg je de kans om te groeien, nieuwe dingen te proberen, je talenten te benutten en verder te ontplooien, … Er heerst een sfeer van samenwerking: together we get the job done. r werk je in ons Innovation Lab

to join our Information Technology team. The Junior Software Engineer position will work on a team focused on our core clinical systems as well as internal applications. Strong attention to detail, innovation, and implementation of new technologies are highly valued.

To meet our global and innovation demands, Medpace is rapidly growing our software development footprint beyond the US. To support our growth, we are expanding our existing office in Leuven
to build our first non-US development center. This is an incredible opportunity to join, contribute, and shape a new team, while also being a part of a large, fast-growing organization. Our custom software is a key component to our success. You will be joining an organization where your contribution makes a significant impact in positively impacting people's lives, as new treatments and therapeutics are developed.

We kindly ask that you submit applications in English.

Responsibilities

Collect, analyze and document user requirements;
Design, modify, develop and support software applications;
Participate in software validation process through development, review, and/or execution of test plan/cases/scripts;
Create software applications by following software development life-cycle, which includes requirements gathering, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance;
Communicate with team members regarding projects, development, tools, and procedures;
Utilize skills in development areas including object oriented programming (C#), databases (SQL) web applications (ASP.NET);
Potential opportunities to lead software development projects.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science;
Familiarity of technologies such as C#, Angular, Webservices, GraphQL, Git, relational databases;
Experience in Entity Framework, Azure DevOps is advantageous;
Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and software release management;
Prior experience modernizing systems to a cloud-based platform (Azure) is a plus;
Excellent analytical, written and oral communication skills in English.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

Office based environment with on-site mentors
Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
Company-sponsored social events

Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
¡Hola! Somos OGA

Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo.

Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico.

Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico.

Sobre la posición.

Buscamos un/a Senior Full Stack Developer con experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web, tanto en el lado del servidor como en el lado del cliente, para unirse a nuestro equipo.

¿Qué harás?

Desarrollarás Software, tanto en Backend como en Frontend.

Diseñarás, desarrollarás y mantendrás aplicaciones web completas, trabajando tanto en el frontend (Angular) como en el backend (.NET), asegurando un código limpio, mantenible y de alta calidad.

Propondrás y definirás arquitecturas de software escalables, eficientes y seguras, alineadas con las necesidades del negocio y las mejores prácticas del sector.

Crearás y consumirás APIs RESTful o GraphQL para garantizar una comunicación fluida entre las capas del frontend y backend, así como con servicios externos.

Diseñarás y administrarás bases de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.) y NoSQL (MongoDB, etc.), asegurando un acceso eficiente, seguro y adaptado al volumen de datos esperado.

Configurarás y mantendrás pipelines de integración y entrega continua, automatizando pruebas, builds y despliegues en entornos cloud o on-premise.

Actuarás como referente técnico, proporcionando retroalimentación constructiva en revisiones de código, guiando a desarrolladores junior y promoviendo la adopción de estándares de desarrollo y buenas prácticas.

Analizarás y mejorarás la velocidad, eficiencia y capacidad de respuesta de las aplicaciones, asegurando una experiencia de usuario óptima.

Trabajarás estrechamente con equipos de producto, diseño, infraestructura y otros departamentos, participando activamente en ceremonias ágiles (sprint planning, dailies, retros, etc.) para garantizar el éxito del proyecto.

Investigarás, evaluarás e implementarás tecnologías emergentes que puedan aportar valor al equipo o a los proyectos.

Timing de primeras semanas en OGA

Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación.

¿Qué requerimos?

Titulación de Grado en Ingeniería del Software, alternativamente, Grado Superior en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web o Aplicaciones Multiplataforma.

Conocimientos en API REST, Docker, Plataforma Cloud: Azure, AWS o GCP y Pruebas unitarias.

Experiencia mínima profesional de 5 años en Desarrollo con framework Microsoft .NET 6, ASP.NET Core 3.1 o superior, en Angular v14, en Desarrollo JavaScript ES6+, HTML 5 y CSS 3, en Patrones de diseño: DDD, Clean Architecture, CQRS y en Lenguaje SQL y diseño de base de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL).

¿Qué valoramos?

Conocimientos en UI/UX.

Uso de herramientas de testing: Postman o Selenium.

Conocimientos de CI & CD.

Conocimientos de Kubernetes.

Conocimientos de Arquitectura de microservicios.

Conocimientos de Python.

Trabajo en equipo en marcos de trabajo Agile y uso de herramientas de gestión

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla.

Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras.

Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos.

Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar tiempos de entrega, aumentar capacidad productiva, minimizar desgastes y sobrecargas, y en definitiva maximizar la eficiencia y rentabilidad de OGA.

Sesión de onboarding con responsables de OGA y de People, en la que te entregaremos tu kit de bienvenida.

Participación en eventos corporativos donde podrás conocer e interactuar con el resto del equipo de una forma distendida y divertida.

Asistencia al congreso anual del Grupo CÁTEDRA en Sevilla, donde se presentan los últimos avances y proyectos en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, con una completa agenda científica, formativa y de debate.

Plan de formación continua. En OGA, la formación continua es un valor clave y un pilar de nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo personal y profesional. Nos inspiramos en el concepto de ikigai, buscando que cada persona encuentre aquello que le motive y le permita crecer dentro de la organización. Por eso, te propondremos acciones formativas que consideremos valiosas para tu crecimiento. Sin embargo, serás tú quien debe tomar la iniciativa en tu propio desarrollo, identificando aquello que te apasiona y proponiendo a tu responsable las formaciones que desees realizar. Juntos evaluareis su viabilidad, su aporte de valor y su alineación con la estrategia de OGA.

Compromiso con la inclusión y la diversidad. En OGA nos tomamos muy en serio el talento. Creemos que cada persona aporta algo único y especial, por lo que es parte de nuestro compromiso ofrecer un ambiente donde todos podáis brillar.

Beneficios sociales y profesionales integrados en un plan global de conciliación. Como ‘entidad familiarmente responsable’ - efr - desde 2015, certificada por la Fundación Másfamilia, en OGA hemos desarrollado un amplio catálogo de beneficios para tu bienestar personal y profesional.

¡Únete a nosotros!

Si te entusiasma nuestra visión innovadora y estás listo/a para enfrentar desafíos diarios con empresas líderes, ¡queremos conocerte! Aplica ahora y únete a OGA para seguir creando soluciones increíbles y de gran impacto.

Por supuesto, si durante el proceso de selección necesitaras algún tipo de asistencia, simplemente avísanos. Nuestro equipo de People te ayudará para asegurarnos de que todo vaya sobre ruedas y tengas una experiencia genial.

¡Te esperamos!

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer (m/f/d)
to join the Data and AI Transformation Engineering team, responsible for designing and building scalable backend platforms that expose AI and automation capabilities as reliable, production grade services.

The role focuses on developing API driven systems deployed on Kubernetes, combining AI driven components with deterministic logic to support complex transformation and automation use cases across multiple business units. Operating in a regulated financial services environment, the role requires a strong engineering mindset with compliance, governance, and responsible use of AI treated as core design principles.

What You Do

Design and maintain RESTful APIs with robust versioning strategies, ensuring stability as model behaviour evolves across releases.
Define structured, validated response schemas that deliver deterministic, auditable outputs suitable for enterprise consumption.
Implement streaming response patterns (SSE / chunked HTTP) to enable real-time model output delivery to frontends and downstream systems.
Implement authentication and authorisation frameworks (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC, scopes) including service principal patterns for cloud-to-cloud integration across Azure, AWS, and Databricks.
Enforce data controls at the API layer — including input sanitisation, output filtering, and guardrails — ensuring responses meet compliance standards before leaving the system.
Build audit logging into the API contract so that every request and response is fully traceable for regulatory purposes.
Design background job patterns that return immediately to callers while model inference executes asynchronously.
Integrate with message queues and event-driven architectures (Azure Service Bus, SQS, Kafka) for pipeline orchestration.
Implement polling and webhook callback mechanisms to deliver results without blocking consumers.
Establish structured logging on every API call — capturing inputs, outputs, latency, and model version metadata.
Integrate with enterprise monitoring platforms (Datadog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch) to ensure full-stack visibility.
Implement drift detection hooks that flag when model outputs deviate from expected patterns.
Manage versioned model endpoints, enabling seamless deployment of new model versions without breaking existing API consumers.
Develop automated testing strategies for non-deterministic outputs, including contract tests, output validation, and regression benchmarks.
Deploy containerised APIs on Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) with health checks, autoscaling, and production-grade reliability.
Wrap managed AI services (Databricks Model Serving, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) behind clean, internal API contracts.

What You Bring

University degree in Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
7+ years of experience in backend engineering with Python, with a proven track record of delivering AI/ML, GenAI, and agentic systems into enterprise production environments (beyond prototypes or proofs of concept).
Hands on experience with cloud based AI services across Azure and AWS, including strong expertise in Databricks (MLflow, Delta Lake, Model Serving).
Strong background in designing clean, versioned APIs and building distributed systems, including asynchronous patterns, background processing, and message based architectures.
Proven experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes, managing infrastructure using Terraform, and treating observability, structured logging, and monitoring as standard engineering practices.
Experience working in regulated environments, where auditability, data controls, security, and compliance are core engineering requirements.
Demonstrated ownership mindset: able to take systems from design through production and incident resolution, collaborate across business units, and create reusable platform patterns that enable other teams.
Good level of English (required), other languages (e.g. Spanish or additional European languages) are nice to have.
We highly welcome candidates with a genuine interest and affinity for Information Technology (IT) and Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), as these attributes are considered valuable assets to our team.

What We Offer

We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered .
Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.

About Allianz

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.

We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the center of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.

Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future – for our customers and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural Internal background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
